scope: One finite independent schema batch against the ten existing c0fe questions and accepted F1 design. No source implementation, goldens, producer test, physical operation or new qualification family.

material_blockers.finding: Each descriptor needs exact record_size and count rules. In particular the fragment query section has an API-specific length of 0, 8, 36, 592 or 8202 bytes, while the section table names the original-profile 8218-byte record size. Independent goldens cannot infer a unique descriptor count/size pair.
material_blockers.resolution: Close the per-section descriptor table for full and fragment profiles, including empty sections and the unique fixed frame length. Preserve the existing contiguous eight-section layout; do not add a section or reinterpret original query ownership.

material_blockers.finding: The exact value representation of absent fragment expected_size is not fixed separately from known zero. The input-handle field has one presence bit and zero bits, so accepting both NULL and HANDLE0 would not roundtrip their distinct tags.
material_blockers.resolution: Specify absent expected_size value/flag/padding and restrict or encode input argument tags explicitly. Grammar's proposed HANDLE-or-UNOBSERVED input domain can remove the NULL collision without changing observed return HANDLE/NULL/zero distinctions.

material_blockers.finding: The canonical error-definition slot has UNOBSERVED, False and True, but call_exact_keys and the two error-definition bits do not yet provide the complete unambiguous value-to-wire mapping and cross-field applicability.
material_blockers.resolution: Specify the input field or exact equivalent representation, the two-bit mapping, raw error observedness/definedness relations and refusal for True on an incompatible successful branch. Do not silently change a stored True into False or infer False from an unobserved sentinel.

material_blockers.finding: The pure API needs exact DecodedLedger.to_dict keys/container types and FormatError code/offset/path types and absent-value rules before independent goldens. Within the same value-surface closure, publication schema_version/scope/status must select explicit new values/domains rather than silently inherit pure_shared_owner_seam; optional call.error_id and the BOOL wire versus BOOL32 source-observation mapping need explicit treatment.
material_blockers.resolution: Close those existing data/interface tables in one successor. The pinned50ee required_gate_order is already resolvable and is not an additional issue. Genuine ProducerSnapshot projection must preserve actual legacy tokens/refs and observed values; decoded data cannot create that authority.

material_blockers.finding: The added live accounting describes per-slot primitive payload as conservatively at most eight bytes. Eight bytes can bound an in-domain logical value bit width, but no physical CPython boxed numeric-storage bound is established; integer digit payload is not merely an object header.
material_blockers.resolution: Explicitly label the added 13,823,488 bytes and combined 127,809,034 bytes as named logical accounting only, excluding boxed numeric payload and other implementation storage from any physical bound. Alternatively provide a justified bound, but no new interpreter/RSS gate is requested here. Never present eight bytes as actual per-Python-value allocation.

coherent_design_rules_not_additional_fin: Canonical preallocated slots retain the first original scalar/count/error/clock object before type validation, observedness flags, folds, packing or clocks. Packed cells are derived; their partial failure cannot erase source facts. This is application ordering after return conversion, not real FFI qualification.

Known zero and NULL derive observedness from sentinel identity, not auxiliary flags. Exact built-in input checks precede comparisons/packing. Signed32 nonzero BOOL, unsigned handles/DWORD/counts and typed I64/F64 clock bits are explicit.
Known wrapper return plus later stop, canonical owned-close rights, partial cache quarantine, failed/unknown read/hash/copy tails and lower bounds remain separate.

The D5056 design borrows two reusable uncommitted diagnostic slots per serial operation rather than consuming two per successful call. First error identity is latched before formatting; committed diagnostics are immutable and unreused. Genuine source debit/fault proof remains pending.
Original paths own one UTF8 pool, final paths remain in complete retained query frames and one reserved comparison workspace. No target path is opened by decoding.
The accepted F1 generated-byte universe and candidate/terminal lifetimes remain closed. Actual same-owner bytes, not manifests or iterators, are required by future byte consumers.

Legacy projection requires a genuine same-owner ProducerSnapshot and refuses dict/DecodedLedger/hash-only/new-profile input. Pure codec roundtrip cannot establish live owner or exception-token provenance.
API IDs 8..14 are not activated as full physical call domains; they are fragment data only. Existing original-only C and storage do not silently absorb writer/readback/scan operations.
non_scope: No reopening of F1 lifetime design, accepted legacy fixtures or N4 caps.
No new codec/producer implementation, extra feature family, original target access, scientific gate or model run.
Full roster, true first entry, raw native-return conversion, physical writer/readback and measured RSS/clock fit remain separate existing prerequisites.
The original consumed189 failure and whole-verification timeout remain unchanged.
